subject: Post-call: Encryption constraints, proof points, and proposed deep-dive
body:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Kowalski <anna.k@finsecure.com>, Carlos Miranda <c.miranda@finsecure.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Encryption constraints, proof points, and proposed deep-dive

Anna / Carlos — thanks again for taking time today. High-level recap + next steps below. Please let me know if I missed anything.

Quick recap (from my notes)
- Scope: Pilot will ingest low-vol volume PII (names, emails, masked SSNs) from support transcripts for NLU & summarization.
- Residency: Pilot data must remain in us-east-1; long-term may need eu residency for specific EU customers.
- Retention: Customer requires 30-day rolling retention for raw transcripts; derived embeddings can be retained up to 90 days for model tuning.
- Logging/telemetry: Security team needs request-level audit logs (user id, request time, model id, token counts) and the ability to export logs to client S3 for 90 days.
- Encryption asks: TLS in transit + AES-256 at rest; preference for customer-managed keys (BYOK) via KMS/HSM with key rotation policy and attestation.

What we are providing today
- Attached: redwood_encryption_matrix_v2.pdf — matrix comparing Hosted vs. Dedicated vs. Private on KMS, HSM, and audited key custody.
- Attached: audit-log-sample.csv — sanitized sample of the request-level logs we can stream to S3.
- Link: HubSpot deal page and an internal design note (links below).

Proposed next steps
1) Security deep-dive (90 minutes) — target audience: your CISO + infra lead; our infra/security + product engineer. Purpose: align on BYOK flow, HSM options, and SLOs for key compromise scenarios. I propose Wed 8/18 10:00–11:30am ET.
2) Demo: short (20–30m) dedicated instance walkthrough showing KMS integration and sample audit export.
3) Pilot scope doc — we'll turn our call notes into an appendix for the SOW (retention windows, export cadence, data residency).

Can you confirm who from FinSecure should attend the deep-dive and whether the proposed time works?

Thanks,

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

---

On Sun, 15 Aug 2027 at 16:20, Anna Kowalski <anna.k@finsecure.com> wrote:
> Thanks Ben — great recap. A few clarifications from our security team after the call:
>
> 1) BYOK model: we absolutely prefer customer-managed keys that we control. We also need to see the key wrapping flow and evidence that Redwood never has plaintext access to the master key. Can you provide a short diagram and any existing attestation?
> 2) HSM: our preference is an HSM-backed KMS that supports FIPS 140-2 Level 3; open to Redwood-hosted HSM if rotation and separation can be demonstrated.
> 3) Logs: the audit sample looks good — please confirm whether logs include a hashed user identifier (not email) and whether token counts are per-call or aggregated per-session.
> 4) Timeline: we are aiming to start the pilot first week of Oct; need SOW by 9/10.
>
> Attendees for deep-dive: Myself (Anna, Security Lead), Carlos (infra), and Gustavo (CISO) — Gustavo prefers mornings ET. The proposed Wed 8/18 10am ET works for us.
>
> —Anna
>

Ben / team — quick internal notes ahead of the deep-dive tomorrow (8/18):

Action owners (high level)
- Soojin: runbook + demo script for BYOK flows (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private). Will include a short sequence diagram and the runtime trust boundary.
- Marissa: collect attestations and SOC2/HSM vendor docs we can share (redacted).
- Karthik: confirm audit log schema and S3 export runbook; add an example CLI command for customers.
- Ben: confirm attendees and lock meeting time; secure a calendar invite with dial-in and Zoom link.

Prep asks (to Ben)
- Add Gustavo (CISO) to the attendee list and loop him into the invite.
- Confirm if FinSecure requires HSM proof that meets FIPS 140-2 L3 — if yes, Marissa should prioritize vendor artifact collection.
- Ask Anna whether they want logs pushed to their S3 or to a Redshift instance (she said S3 but double-check).

I'll assemble the runbook snippets and attach to the invite as a working doc. Keep the deep-dive technical — engineering + security-only for first 45 minutes, then we can open to program managers.

Soojin
